name: Rathty
source: Rathty is a Mining Elf who is good at making weapons and hardware. Arawn’s first impression of Rathty is that she is a boy. She tried to hide her gender as a female in order to stay with the party. Although Rathty is a weapons dealer she secretly wishes to sell household appliances.
